Camilla Leidcker is a clinical development nurse affiliated with Hvidovre Hospital in the Capital Region of Denmark (Region Hovedstaden) [^src1]. She serves as the representative for the professional society for gastroenterological nurses (Fagligt selskab for Gastroenterologiske sygeplejersker) within the national healthcare quality infrastructure [^src1]. 

Leidcker is a member of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen-styregruppe]], the governing steering committee for the Acute Surgery Database (Akut Kirurgi Databasen) [^src1]. Her position on this committee highlights the interdisciplinary and cross-regional structure of the database's governance, which operates under the Danish Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The inclusion of nursing representatives like Leidcker underscores the critical role that clinical nursing professionals play in the quality development, auditing, and operational oversight of acute surgical pathways in Denmark [^src1]. 

Her membership and professional affiliations are documented in the 2023 annual report for the Acute Surgery Database, which outlines the clinical indicators, steering committee composition, and regional operational challenges associated with acute surgery registrations [^src1].
